supporting_evidence.quote: Power Generation – Sales increased mainly in turbines and turbine-related services and in large reciprocating engines, primarily in data center applications.

input.reasoning_summary: The claim is purely qualitative/interpretive, asserting that data center applications contributed to the increase in Caterpillar's Power Generation sales in Q3 2026. Evidence E1, from Caterpillar's 10-Q filed 2026-11-04 for the period ending 2026-09-30 (Q3 2026), explicitly states that "Power Generation – Sales increased mainly in turbines and turbine-related services and in large reciprocating engines, primarily in data center applications." This directly supports the claim that data center applications contributed to the Power Generation sales increase in Q3 2026. The evidence affirmatively establishes the causal attribution stated in the claim.
